title: Improved Quickbuy
description:
Shows the souls you're still missing for your queued items, right in the HUD.

- Up to 5 quickbuy items on the HUD (1 = vanilla)
- "Missing souls" badge above each item, counted along your queue
- Shop: running totals per queued item and a total for the whole queue
- Integrated into [CompLock HUD++](https://deadlockconfig.com/): its own "Quickbuy" tab, every feature togglable
- Works without HUD++: an ADDONS button in the Esc menu opens its own settings window
- "Reset tab" back to the defaults, and a "Saved" line, like CompLock's own tabs
- In every language Deadlock ships, following the game's language
- Rewritten from scratch with performance in mind

Inspired by Enhanced Quickbuy by Aminsx (gamebanana.com/mods/664041). Written from scratch; contains no code or assets from it.
author: luxus
